resources.string: To recalculate (bring to the norm) or fix a mistake you can enter a volume with a minus sign. The ± key flips the sign. If the row\'s total fact would drop below zero, the app warns you.
Minus: the volume is subtracted from the row\'s fact.
Total fact will be below zero (%1$s). You can still save.
Total fact will be below zero

resources.string: Fact is the work actually done. A field person (foreman, site manager) enters it as volumes. Fact does not yet mean the work was handed to the client.
F-2 is the act of completed work handed to and accepted by the client. Payments follow this document. Fact is work still being prepared for an F-2.
The estimate lists the planned work of an object with volumes and prices. The object value comes from it.

The object value is shown with VAT (QQS, 12 %) first. Below are two VAT-free sums: \"with markup\" is direct cost plus overheads and planned profit; \"without markup\" is only work, materials and labour (direct cost). All sums come from the server; the phone never calculates them.
The outer ring is the percent of the estimate done (fact). The inner ring is the percent accepted in F-2. Above 100 % means more work was done than the estimate.
Fact and F-2 as a percent of each section\'s estimate amount. Amounts are not shown per section, only percentages.
View only. Estimates are edited on the website.
You do not have the right to view F-2 for this object. Ask your manager.
Once an F-2 is prepared for accepted work it will appear here.
Open the F-2 registry on the website
F-2 PDF and Excel files open in the app with the \"F-2 documents\" button. Sums are in the website registry.
The document total differs from the sum of rows in the system. Check on the website.
The act\'s sums (with VAT, with and without markup) are shown in the F-2 registry on the website.
Draft: the document is still being prepared and was not sent to the client.
Submitted: the document is under review, waiting for an answer.
Checked: passed the internal check, waiting for approval.
Accepted: the document is approved and its sum counts in the object\'s F-2 total.
Rejected: the document was returned, fix it and send again.
Cancelled: the document no longer counts.
Superseded: a new version replaced it.
Status unknown. Check the registry on the website.
No access to the boss panel
The panel is for company management and users with the finance right.
Offline — the panel is not saved yet
Outer ring: fact, inner ring: F-2 (against the estimate)
Three bars per month: work done (F-2), payments received and costs. A short grey bar means the data was not entered.
Documents waiting for a manager\'s decision
Problems the system found: the most important first. Tap a row with an object name to open its card.
Work done but F-2 not handed over
Payment overdue by more than 60 days

The estimate as on the website: section (RZ) → work (BL) → resources (RS labour/machines, MAT materials, OB equipment). Tap a section to open it. Search shows a matching row together with its parent sections. Row amounts are VAT-free and without markup; the VAT-inclusive and with-markup amounts are in the object value above.
